slug: 2025-11-09 Government Finalizes Sierra Leones Data Protection and Right to Access Information Bill

facts.fact: Minister of Information and Civic Education Chernor Bah said the Data Protection and Right to Access Information Bill, 2025 concluded its final national validation, with drafting input from Parliament, local councils, security agencies, the Electoral Commission, civil society, media, academia and the private sector.
facts.system: Data Protection and Right to Access Information Bill, 2025
